entities.title: UTV-first examples
entities.summary: The Rust library's examples, as unit tests organized by UTV type and function, each compared with chrono, chrono-tz or std.
entities.purpose: Shows how to do every scenario of docs/example-tests.md with UTV, one file per UTV type or free function and one inner module per function (civil_date::add_months::returns_none_when_the_day_is_missing_from_the_target_month). Where UTV and chrono agree, the expected value is computed with chrono; where they differ it is a literal, and the doc comment's "Compared with:" sentence says what chrono does. Tests between // BEGIN <task> and // END <task> are copied onto docs/side-by-side.md by tools/side_by_side.py.
boundaries: One integration-test target, built from main.rs; cargo test --test utv_first runs it alone.
UTV's zone operations use the pinned demo rules through tests/fixtures; chrono-tz uses the tz database compiled into it, never the host's.
The same scenarios from chrono's side live in tests/native_first.
